text.content:
The price of the supercarrier. Night City law stops at the gate.

Region: Watson (district F). Was: the NorCal Military Base and the Watson waterfront
Controlled by: Arasaka Security, with no city law at all
The feel of it: Floodlit docks, a refitted military base, construction everywhere, and a supercarrier offshore
Notable locations: The supercarrier, the container docks, the old base
Danger: Extraterritorial. SC 10 (Arasaka Security, Hardened Heavy). UC 1

Under the Arvin Accord, Arasaka took the Watson waterfront and the old NorCal base behind it and fenced the lot. It is now Arasaka's main port in the Western Hemisphere, and nobody who goes in uninvited is ever reported as arrested.

What You Can See

From the bridge or the Danger Gal roof: the supercarrier at anchor in Coronado Bay since the Accord, which Arasaka calls a "visiting vessel"; docks handling container ships around the clock, none of it through city customs; the old base, refitted and lit all night; and construction everywhere, a city inside the city.

Accord Law

  • No city law. The NCPD cannot follow you in.
  • Trespassers are "processed": rumor says interrogation, then a contract you can't refuse or a hole you can't climb out of.
  • Passes come from Arasaka or an Arasaka sponsor. Forgeries exist, cost a fortune, and last a day.
  • Leaving. You're under city law the moment you're through the gate, and what you carried out is legally yours. Arasaka remembers anyway.

Getting There

NCART: NorCal Gate (closed); Business Connect planned.

Turf

Arasaka. Nobody else.

People

  • Colonel Sato Ren (Solo 8). Commander of Waterfront security.
  • Jun "Gatekeeper" Moss (Fixer 6). Sells Waterfront day-labor passes in a bar outside the fence, with Arasaka's knowledge.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.08
